descriptionChirho: The Greek form of the Hebrew name Shimon, borne by several NT individuals including Simon Peter (the leading apostle), Simon the Zealot, Simon of Cyrene, Simon the leper, Simon the tanner, and Simon Magus. All 75 occurrences represent the same proper name across nominative, vocative, accusative, genitive, and dative case forms. Multilingual translations uniformly transliterate: Swahili 'Simoni/Simon', Hindi 'Shamoun/Shamaon', Korean 'Simon', Arabic Sim-an (سِمْعَانُ), Spanish Simon. The S76445 cluster (3x, accusative/dative with prepositional phrases) is merely a case-form variant of S76443 (72x, all cases) with no semantic difference; the particular individuals referred to are determined by context, not by the morphological form of the name itself.
